title: Teach the active platform path only
when: At platform detection, a named prerequisite refusal, or a move to a different operating system.
need: Use the verified OS/harness combination and its filesystem, restart, permissions and login-lifetime rules; do not promise unverified desktop support from CLI support.
surface: WSL setup, launcher PATH helpers, terminal onboarding and Linux reference
gap: Coverage exists in several references but is not a complete tested scenario matrix. Review question: should FIRST-USER D/E expose per-platform evidence and offer only the active-platform recovery?
